title: Figure in a line
description: One figure that matters, large, with its unit and what it measures beside it. Lines follow one another in reading order; the marker number links a line to a numbered marker of the figure next to it.
instructions: Keep the value to a number (formatted for the course language) and the label to a few words. Put the unit in unit, not in value. Use marker only when a figure on the same screen shows the same number. Lines revealed one by one read as a list that grows.

value.description: The figure, formatted for the course language.

label.description: What the figure measures, in a few words.

marker.description: Number of the matching marker in a figure on the same screen.
